consensusPolicy: Consensus price per asset = median of entries with consensus.role = "member" that are fresh, after converting ETH/BTC/underlying quotes to USD with the ETH, BTC (reference) and underlying consensus. Two fresh members form a consensus only while they sit within two bands of each other: further apart, their midpoint would paint both as outliers and nothing says which is wrong, so the asset shows no consensus. At most one member per provider family; a lending-market oracle is a member only when it is the sole path for that family. "alternate" = another market feed from a family that already has a member; "derived" = computed only from member feeds; "basis" = exchange-rate / capped / fixed / peg-assumed prices that legitimately differ from market — show a basis bar, never paint them as outliers naively.
stalenessPolicy: stale when now − updatedAt > heartbeatSeconds + grace (grace = max(600 s, 10% of heartbeat)); a stale entry is never green and never counts toward consensus. Entries with no updatedAt of their own (views) inherit freshness from their components, stale when any leg is stale: a leg that is itself a catalog entry is judged by that entry’s own verdict at the same moment (by that entry’s own limit when it has no verdict); any other leg against its own declared heartbeat + grace or, when it declares none, against its entry’s heartbeat + grace (the 90,000 s age-only bound below when neither declares one). A timestamp that is only the read time (Spark’s medians) is not an update time. A push feed that exposes no timestamp is never green. Pull oracles (Pyth on Ethereum) are stale when older than 3,600 s and are expected to be stale. A push feed with no on-chain heartbeat (Chronicle) is stale when older than 90,000 s (25 h) — the acceptable source age Spark’s own median oracle applies to these same Chronicle feeds, not a bound invented here.

consensus.note: sUSDe vault rate × capped USDT/USD — ignores both the USDe market price and the 7-day cooldown discount

mechanism.source: sUSDe.convertToAssets (ERC-4626 rate) × Aave capped USDT/USD
mechanism.aggregation: price = min(rate, snapshotRatio × (1 + maxGrowth × Δt)) × min(USDT/USD, $1.04)
mechanism.fallback: none — rate above the cap is clipped

governance.steeredBy: Aave governance + risk stewards (ACL RISK_ADMIN / POOL_ADMIN)

entries.label: Morpho sUSDe/PYUSD oracle

consensus.note: sUSDe vault rate × Chainlink USDe/USD ÷ PYUSD/USD — ignores the cooldown discount on sUSDe

mechanism.source: sUSDe ERC-4626 rate (BASE_VAULT) × Chainlink USDe/USD ÷ Chainlink PYUSD/USD
mechanism.aggregation: price() = SCALE_FACTOR × (BASE_VAULT rate) × BASE_FEED_1 × BASE_FEED_2 ÷ (QUOTE_FEED_1 × QUOTE_FEED_2); a zero-address feed counts as 1
mechanism.fallback: none — a reverting or stale-but-not-reverting feed passes straight through to Morpho Blue

governance.steeredBy: immutable (MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 constructor args); markets are immutable too
governance.note: a market cannot change oracle — a "change" is a new market

entries.label: Chronicle SUSDS/USD

consensus.note: Chronicle family member for sUSDS (sUSDS↔USDS redemption is atomic, so rate-based and market prices coincide)

mechanism.source: Chronicle Scribe oracle wat()="SUSDS/USD": validators sign (value, age) off-chain
mechanism.aggregation: Schnorr multi-signature; poke accepted only with bar() = 13 of 25 lifted validators (read 2026-10-05); ScribeOptimistic opPoke path has a 600 s challenge window
mechanism.fallback: none at feed level
mechanism.access: tolled: on-chain consumers must be whitelisted (kiss); eth_call from address(0) is allowed for off-chain reads
mechanism.notes: Heartbeat / deviation thresholds are not exposed on-chain; see the Chronicle dashboard.

mechanism.aggregation: price = chi / 1e27 × 1e8

entries.label: Aave PT oracle (linear discount, capped USDT/USD)

consensus.note: deterministic linear discount to maturity; never reacts to the PT market — compare with the Pendle TWAP

mechanism.source: linear discount schedule × Aave capped USDT/USD
mechanism.aggregation: price = USDT/USD(capped) × (1 − discountRatePerYear × timeToMaturity / 1y)
mechanism.pegAssumption: PT redeems to 1 USDT-equivalent at maturity
mechanism.fallback: none
